notes.title: Car Trader Simulator - Update v0.9.8.0a
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Car Traders![/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31151725/0583814fc95dc11d3fd57832770862d6d44ca9f5.png[/img]

Hello, hello Car Traders, how are your businesses doing these days? They're definitely about to get better pretty soon as we are happy to announce a new update! Check below what has changed - we believe you will quite like what we've prepared for you... 


[list][*] A special Christmas user Interface is now available during five weeks of every in-game winter! Will you notice all the visual tweaks and changes that we have prepared for you to feel the Christmas spirit? 
[*] Mod Tools - you can add your own cars to the game and become even better Car Trader with Santa Claus sledge in your garage! We cannot wait to see your additions and creations
[*] Added two new songs - variety never hurts, right?
[*] Over 30 reported minor and major issues fixed![/list]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31151725/39328ac602ebe077518ae2e233c79372a60278b7.png[/img]

After updating the game to the newest version you will see a new addition on the main menu of the game - a Mods Icon. Simply by clicking on it you will have a chance to access the menu for mods allowing you to add new cars to the game. Now it's the time to let your imagination go wild because any and all cars will do. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31151725/8665a9c300acd0d8ed4e584dd2ca339c7861919a.png[/img]

This is how the mods window looks like. As you can see it has many different options but do not worry - creating a new car is not complicated at all. In order to do so you will have to create a New Package with the "Create Package" option. You can name the package as you prefer. After that is done you will then have an opportunity to create new cars within that particular package. Several options await here allowing you to customize your car as per your wishes and preferences. You can even set whether this particular car will appear damaged or fully repaired in game! 

Last but not least you can choose your own photos for your car. Remember to upload them first to an appropriate folder! In order to see the folder path please put your mouse cursor on the question mark visible in the left top corner of the screen. 

[b][u]Please remember to start new game when using mods - the older save files might work with the addition of mods but there is a risk of them becoming corrupted and not functioning properly. [/u][/b]

[u]Thank you for sending us your reports and all of the output_logs we received from you! We still await any and all reports you might have - don't be a stranger![/u]

Best regards,
Car Trader Simulator team

notes.title: Car Trader Simulator - Update v0.9.7.8a
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Car Traders![/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31151725/1604390313e9df5e7cceeefa03b8d2f678d4112f.png[/img]

Welcome again! We are happy to let you know that we are introducing another set of changes aimed at enhancing your enjoyment and fixing many of the issues that you have brought to our attention. As we do so we are still encouraging you to post all your feedback and let us know about any possible issues that you are experiencing!  

[b]New fixes[/b]:[list]
[*] (Fixed) Players weren’t able to complete “have one superstar employee” task
[*] (Fixed) After finishing campaign mode players weren’t able to continue their game because week report wasn’t popping up 
[*] (Fixed) By bringing the 2nd driver to the mission point players were able to block their campaign 
[*] (Fixed) The marker of the deceased employee remained on the map
[*] (Fixed) Loss of employee equipment when he died in an event
[*] (Fixed) Tutorial - if you left the car you meant to pick up on the map for longer period of time it disappeared
[*] (Fixed) A phone blocked by a player does not hide after negotiations
[*] “Scrap Overflow” Achievement is now working properly
[*] The family loan had a repayment time of less than one minute - now properly reflects the information in-game
[*] Many other minor bugfixes

[*] Full Russian Campaign Translation ( Thanks to our community members: Daniel Rogovskoy, Freestyler2018, Frenkyns, Leontij, Michalo, Olexsus, Vovkan, Zoqibo)

We have something really amazing coming to our game in the following weeks. It starts with an “M” and ends with an “S”. Can you guess what it is? Let us know in the comments section!

Best regards,
Car Trader Simulator team

notes.title: Car Trader Simulator Devlog #53 - "New features!" - 4 days left!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Car Traders![/b][/h1]

[h2]This time we'll talk about some of the new features that you might expect in the EA version of the game![/h2]

We're increasing the number of garages available for you to buy and use! As you might have already notice using only one garage when dealing with multiple sales and purchases is a little bit problematic so very soon you'll have a chance to spread your wings and own more than just one garage!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31151725/cf2559e7f1d3e32511e319ea6f12be76fd1c90e1.png[/img]

Training Center will be the place where you'll be able to send your employees to gain some extra knowledge. It will take some time and you will have to pay a little for this particular convenience but as they say - knowledge is power! As you can see on the screenshot there's a chance that your employee will receive a lot of experience this way so it might be wise to try this particular service!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31151725/c609f2e6fe82d4fa88b0e152fbc4ae0ec9426e1a.png[/img]

Car Dealerships will be a separate option for car sales. If you're not so much interested in talking with the customers you may simply drop your car at your Car Dealership and done, voila! Folks at the service will take care of selling it for you for approximately similar amount of money as its value. It will definitely speed up the process of selling and make it possible for you to focus on bigger or more important sales!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31151725/84b92de4ecd90ff3b8d47b384bd2184b70b56633.png[/img]

Docks are becoming fully available - meaning that you can take your chances and see if you're lucky enough to receive some great cars or bust completely. Docks will allow you a chance to gamble your hard-earned money - for set price and after waiting some time you'll receive a container that can have almost anything inside - great cars, horrible cars, nothing at all or just some scrap. It's your choice to use their services - sometimes they might help you with taking off with your business but sometimes they can shut you down hard. Be careful! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31151725/643e38ffa7aa3a053564a55514883e920da12883.png[/img]

Full campaign will also be released in the Early Access version of the game! You will be able to go through an interesting story separated in three different paths - which path you will take depends only on you and your choices. We hope you will like what we prepared for you and be prepared - there's going to be a lot of things to do! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31151725/b016b4656f45382a8987e2881c6d67a428e5ed45.png[/img]



Hey! Remember that our community challenge is on-going! Just to remind you here are the goals you need to reach in order to receive rewards! Good luck!

notes.title: Car Trader Simulator Devlog #52 - "New is always better!" - 6 days left!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Car Traders![/b][/h1]

[h2]As the EA game release is getting closer we have some information for you regarding what you may expect in the next days.[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31151725/16bc8407324190439f2910d76714b742f6639910.png[/img]

[b]Save Files and new features[/b]:
First of all - if you were playing our demo or prologue and were developing your own company in those versions of our game - unfortunately the save files from those versions will not be compatible with the EA version of the game. 

That means that you will have to start from the beginning in the new version of Car Trader Simulator, however we would like to let you know why will that need to happen. Short answer here is that using older save files might lead to unexpected errors in the game, game bugging out or freezing completely - all of them preventing you from truly having fun in the game. 

That is because in Early Access version of the game you will find many new functions, options and possibilities (and a campaign!) that simply weren't there in prologue and demo version of the game. As such we are sure that you will have fun creating your new car empire with those extra functions that were unavailable in the game before. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31151725/7826e06dc89722c4c2d2ed9447a975b0aaaebebf.jpg[/img]
[i]Can you spot any new additions on the screenshot above?[/i]

Additionally we would like to let you know about the price of the game that you might expect upon the launch, on 04.11.20 for the whole duration of the Early Access period. You will be able to become a true Car Trader for $9.99 during that time and we are hoping to see you in-game very soon!

notes.title: Car Trader Simulator Devlog #47 - "Equipment"
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Car Traders![/b][/h1]

[h2]What is a mechanic without his wrench and tools? What is a thief without lockpicks? What is a driver without a car or a truck? In this devlog we will talk about equipment available for our employees![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31151725/955dd260907718b70e92c9e4407fc9040681c280.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31151725/ec34abd0f0a863e412644eb1aab88261930da8b9.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31151725/7bed342a7db7e60c0e1e1a8c9d64c967712423f2.jpg[/img]

Unless they get into accident, of course... but let's not talk about that![/b]

notes.title: Car Trader Simulator Devlog #38 - "Logo and Company Name"
notes.content:

Of course, we can enter our own name for our company - we believe our players have their own great ideas for the company's name!

What are your thoughts? How would you name your company? What logo would you choose? Leave us a comment with your proposition!

We also had to ask for pictures and permission to use pictures of those cars.
